purpose: Stop normal deepening when a lane has reached a genuine theorem/adapter endpoint or is only being renamed/repackaged, then rotate to the next highest-value non-stalled gate.
substantive_progress_any_of: a new identity or lemma is actually proved
a receiver is strictly weakened and the implication to the prior receiver is proved
a concrete hypothesis/range/measure obstruction is eliminated
a published theorem is verified to apply on the exact receiver
the gate status changes on exact audited evidence
does_not_reset_stall_counter: renaming a missing lemma without a proved implication
equivalent repackaging of the same theorem gate
repeating a broad literature search already covered by merged work
introducing a stronger sufficient condition when the weaker receiver remains open
moving the same cross-measure or quantifier-order gap to a new label

stop_rules.theorem_gate_rule: Once exact algebraic/measure normalization is exhausted and the next step is an actual external theorem or same-measure power estimate, freeze the current FIRST_MISSING_LEMMA. Do not keep subdividing it unless a new proof/source removes a concrete obstruction.

reopen_triggers: new merged repo lemma that changes the exact receiver
new primary-source theorem with exact receiver/range match
focused Work result that discharges or strictly narrows the frozen missing lemma
rotation_priority: non-stalled supporting gate with deepest merged prior work
firewalls: Stopping a lane does not close its EXTERNAL_GATE.
A paused or stalled lane cannot be counted as a saving.
No fixed-U, average-modulus, ambient-population, or different-measure result is promoted without an exact adapter.
CURRENT_PHYSICAL_WHOLE_FAMILY_EXPONENT remains 1/2 unless the actual Stage27 whole-family theorem closes.
No perfect-cuboid existence/nonexistence conclusion follows from a stop or rotation decision.
